 UECL: Reis Rules Onuachu Out Of Trabzonspor’s Clash With Hearts
 by 
 Affa Acho 
 1 hour ago 
 in 
 Sport , Football 
 Share on WhatsApp Share on Facebook Share on X Telegram 
 Trabzonspor will be without Paul Onuachu for Thursday’s(Today), UEFA Europa Conference League matchday-three fixture against Heart of Midlothian at Papara Park, head coach Thomas Reis has confirmed.
 The Nigerian striker picked up an injury in Trabzonspor’s 4-2 victory over Finnish side KuPS last Thursday. Onuachu scored the opening goal in the third minute before being substituted seven minutes later.
 Reis told a pre-match press conference that the Hearts game comes too soon for Onuachu and suggested the forward could return for the club’s Turkish Super Lig match against Rizespor. The Trabzonspor coach also said the fixture is too early for Mustafa’s return.
